lead.t: Septic arthritis (also called infectious arthritis) is an acute, usually bacterial, invasion of a synovial joint space that provokes intense inflammation, rapid cartilage destruction and potential systemic sepsis if untreated.

snip.t: Septic arthritis (also called infectious arthritis) is an acute, usually bacterial, invasion of a synovial joint space that provokes intense inflammation, rapid cartilage destruction and potential systemic sepsis if untreated.
Cartilage cannot regenerate — infectious arthritis must be treated promptly or permanent deformity ensues
